description: No annual security awareness training for employees.
applicability: This signal applies to: Organizations processing, storing, or transmitting cardholder data Security and compliance teams Human resources and training departments Third-party service providers (TPSPs) Incident response teams

related_controls: 12.6 - Security awareness education is an ongoing activity
metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for absence of documented security awareness program, training materials, attendance records, and acknowledgment forms. Verify annual training completion for all personnel with access to cardholder data or the CDE. Check for training content covering security policies, acceptable use, and incident reporting.

sources.title: PCI DSS v4.0
sources.section: Requirement 12: Support Information Security with Organizational Policies
